svg.title: The network: boring on purpose
svg.desc: Logical network map. The internet reaches an ISP 10G PON gateway that is the router. A flat LAN, 192.168.1.0/24, connects the mini PC and two Tenda Nova mesh nodes in AP mode. Inside the mini PC: adguard .53, tailscale .55, coolify .60, home assistant, beszel .62, uptime kuma .63 and frigate .61. A camera is plugged into mesh node B and streams video to Frigate. A phone anywhere connects through a Tailscale tunnel to the tailscale container, which is a subnet router and exit node.

g.text: Logical view. One flat LAN, with a Tailscale overlay.
